events.what: Christoph, Draganić, Girão, Hurley, Michel and Müyesser prove la(G) ≤ Δ/2 + O(log n)
Mishra proves la(G) ≤ k+1 for 2k-regular graphs of girth at least 2k
JCMCC paper attributed to 'Yuina Tanaka' claiming the conjecture for certain graph products
events.credibility_reason: Record could not verify the author exists, found no preprint, and notes the venue's indexing is questioned; no source opened for the claim itself.

judgement.doubts: Mishra's result is a single-author unrefereed preprint with no uptake; it is a genuine case (a graph class) but nobody has checked it. If it failed, the status would fall to progress on the July 2025 bound. Status, AI role and direction are all kept.

outcome_prefix: The status rests on Mishra's December 2025 preprint proving the conjectured bound for 2k-regular graphs of girth at least 2k, a case of the conjecture.

corrections.why: F8: the record says the status is 'partial' because of the December 2025 girth result, but the event field describes the July 2025 bound, which only counts as progress.

corrections.from: Christoph, Draganić, Girão, Hurley, Michel, Müyesser, Mishra
corrections.why: F8: credited humans must describe the event the status rests on, which is Mishra's single-author paper.
F8: the status sources are now limited to the event the status rests on. The July 2025 bound stays in the record's sources.
